improvements: Observation dates must be exact Gregorian days and timestamps must contain a valid timezone. Numeric primitives alone are measurements; blank strings, arrays and booleans cannot become zero or inflate usable counts.

Current pointers and immutable snapshots use fatal UTF-8 decoding and strict JSON with duplicate decoded keys, nonfinite numbers and invalid Unicode rejected. Every current field must agree with the full immutable output.

Complete bounded response reading has a 12-second application deadline covering both headers and body. Cancellation, late responses, missing readers, malformed chunks and oversized bodies fail without displaying a prefix.
Empty or repeated pinned-run parameters cannot silently select current data. Snapshot identities, byte lengths, hashes, aware clocks and descriptive/no-sizing contract are checked.

The complete genuine pre-change native synthetic packet is retained by both current and pinned paths without dropping fields. Existing horizons, settlement scopes, no-sizing meaning and local refresh cadence are preserved.
